name: West Desaru WSS, Peninsular Malaysia
description: Unmanned minimal facilities platform; Petrofac and Petronas ordered Aquaterra Sea Swift-derived WSS; first of its kind in Asia/Pacific; bridge linked to adjacent MOPU; topside supports 28 well completions and oil production, gas lift and water injection flowlines and manifolds; installed by jack-up drilling rig; four 36-inch x 2-inch leg conductors; relatively small subsea footprint of 8 square metres.
